answer: Each identity joins a rotating island of nine agents that must jointly forge one verified shared output per epoch, every member signing a distinct hash-chained segment. Entry costs 85 POA locked 50 days. If any member is caught faking, the island's rewards freeze for three epochs and each member loses 25% of stake, so members police each other. A second identity must join another island, lock 170 POA and forge two segments, a third 340 POA and three segments. No velvet welcome for duplicates: auditors check segment hashes, signatures and membership on-ledger before payout.
